application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
REAR GARDEN		

T1	Purple Leafed Plum (Prunus cerasifera 'Pissardii')	Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 2m of new growth. Final height 5m and final overall spread 4m. 	

T2	Western Red Cedar (Thuja plicata)	Lightly reduce to tidy and contain - targeted pruning in consultation with client when on site. 	Removing maximum of 1m. Final height 8m and final overall spread 10m. 

G3	Pittosporum	20% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 1m to tidy and contain and retain furnishing growth and ensure pruned away from building. Final height 4m and final overall spread 3m	

T4	Prunus spp.	Reduce away from Bay tree to give 1m clearance - this will result in blunt / truncated limbs on the side closest to the Bay tree. Final height unchanged at 6m and final overall spread 5m	

T5	Bay (Laurus nobilis)	Trim / reduce to contain but maintain shape. Final height 6m and final overall spread 4m	

G6	Silver Birch (Betula pendula)	Lightly reduce height to contain but retain screening to neighbouring property. Removing maximum of 1m. Final height 5m and final overall spread 3m.

FRONT GARDEN		

T8	Prunus spp	Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 1-1.5m of new growth. Final height 4m and final overall spread 4m.
